notes: This is a theoretical/cosmological paper deriving a lower bound on the QCD axion mass in the post-inflationary scenario from string-produced axion dark matter abundance. It is not an experimental exclusion limit, and no tabulated (mass, coupling) data points are provided in the extracted content. The result is a bound on f_a / m_a (the abstract mentions m_a > naive misalignment bound, fa ≳ 3.7e9 GeV, ma ≲ 1.5e-3 eV for pre-inflationary). The mentioned g_agamma curves are existing constraints overlaid for context, not new limits.
